jobs.description: Headquarters: California URL: http://www.reframespace.com About Reframe Space Reframe Space Inc. is a fast-growing, US-based office space innovation company focused on helping businesses optimize their workplaces. Our products include office sound pods and modular conference rooms that make office space more flexible and functional. We grew rapidly the past year and are looking for someone to join our young, remote-focused team. We value initiative, clear communication, and consistent follow-through as we continue to grow. About the role You will own the day-to-day processes that build our organic digital marketing growth over time: developing prospect lists, running email and LinkedIn outreach, coordinating content production, and maintaining an active social media presence. This role is about steady execution, thoughtful follow-up, and improving results through a consistent process. You don’t need to be an expert in every channel. We’re looking for practical marketing experience, familiarity with lead-generation tools, and a willingness to learn. You will work with external content and video creators, oversee their output, and own the publishing process; you are not expected to produce all content yourself. This role does not include paid advertising management. Experience working with US companies and willingness to work US business hours are required. Check that messaging, visuals, and product information are accurate and consistent. · Organize product photography, installation photos, testimonials, videos, and other marketing assets so they are easy to find and reuse. · Help adapt and repurpose existing material into captions, graphics, short videos, emails, and website content. Basic knowledge of social media video creation is preferred; advanced production skills are not required. · Learn and experiment with AI-assisted content and video-generation tools such as Higgsfield.
